description: WTGs will have a maximum height ranging from 591 to 617 feet.
context_quote: The maximum height of each turbine is proposed to range from 591 to 617 feet (ft) (180 to 188 meters [m]), measured from mean sea level (MSL) to rotor tip.

description: Export Cable will be buried to a target depth of approximately 6.6 ft.
context_quote: The target depth of burial for the Export Cable remains approximately 6.6 ft (2 m), as previously approved in the RAP.

description: Onshore Interconnection Cable Route must avoid wetlands and other jurisdictional waterbodies.
context_quote: All onshore construction activities will still occur along existing road rights-of-way and/or within previously disturbed areas as described in the approved RAP, and will still avoid wetlands.

description: Bubble curtains will be used during pile driving to minimize acoustic impacts.
context_quote: Dominion has also committed to use of a double bubble curtain during pile driving activities to minimize acoustic impacts.

description: Pile driving will occur only during daylight hours.
context_quote: Pile driving activities will occur during daylight hours only, starting approximately 30 minutes after dawn and ending approximately 30 minutes prior to dusk.

description: Onshore Interconnection Cable will require a 30 ft temporary construction right-of-way.
context_quote: To support the construction and operation of the Onshore Interconnection Cable and Fiber Optic Cable, Dominion proposes a 30 ft (9.1 m) temporary construction right-of-way along the entirety of the route for installation of the cable.
